documents.title: Dallas County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 135 pages. Amounts are the Category amounts and totals written into Appropriation Ordinances 2025-25 and 2025-24 (adopted Nov. 20, 2025); the "2026 Proposed" worksheets were not used column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
